title: status
description: The health of one thing or many: one item renders as a hero with its numbers and the one thing to fix, many as a matrix with problems first.

name.description: What is checked: Studio Mac, Cron, API, Production.

state.description: The item’s state. Drives the glyph, the colour, the default headline and the sort order (critical, warning, unverified, stale, pending, info, ok).

headline.description: The state in words for the hero and compact layouts: “Needs attention”, “Production is healthy”. Default from state: Healthy, Note, Needs attention, Down, Not checked, No recent report, Checking.

detail.description: One line: what is wrong, or why it is fine. “2 jobs failed”, “Disk is 88% full; everything else is normal.”

label.description: Short: CPU, Memory, Disk, Up, p95.

items.description: A small number about the item. Shown in the hero’s well; hidden in the matrix and compact layouts (put the one that matters in `detail`).

metrics.description: Up to four small numbers (CPU, memory, disk, uptime). Unknown is `value: null`, shown as —.

fix.description: The one thing to fix, for warning and critical items: “Delete APFS snapshots older than 30 days to free about 212 GB.” Shown in the hero in a tinted box.

since.description: When it entered this state: “since 06:00”, “for 3 h”.

evidence.description: How the state is known: the check that ran, a log, a dashboard, or a claim (“Said by Synology’s email”).

actions.description: Row actions; they send their id with `{item: <item id>}`.

items.description: One thing whose health is reported.
The things checked. One item renders as a hero; the client sorts the rest problems first.

layout.description: auto: 1 item → hero, 2+ → matrix. compact: one item in one line; the client draws the hero instead when that item isn’t ok.
